name: music-for-url
description: 多平台歌单转播放链接 · Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.test: node scripts/test.cjs && npm --prefix cloudflare test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.build:worker: npm run build && npm --prefix cloudflare run build:worker
scripts.check:pages: node cloudflare/node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js pages functions build functions --outdir .pages-build --build-output-directory web/dist --compatibility-date=2026-10-03
scripts.build:pages: npm run build && npm run check:pages
